news.headline: Loan growth, fall in provisions help SBI profits in Q2
news.summary: State Bank of India reported a 14% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 23,038 crore, driven by 18% loan growth, higher net interest income, lower deposit costs and reduced loan loss provisions.

news.headline: Diwali stocks by Motilal Oswal: Eternal, Adani Ports among 10 stocks with upside of up to 40%. See full list
news.summary: Motilal Oswal has identified ten stocks poised for remarkable growth in the market landscape. Anticipated leaders like Kotak Mahindra Bank and Titan are forecasted to achieve significant earnings boosts. Projections for FY27 suggest a revival of double-digit growth across various sectors. Notably, Adani Ports and Eternal stand out among the select recommendations, urging investors to consider these stocks for their portfolios.

news.headline: Sebi levies Rs 40 lakh penalty on four entities in Axis MF front-running case
news.summary: Securities and Exchange Board of India has imposed a total penalty of Rs 40 lakh on four entities. This penalty includes fines on Woodstock Broking and Marfatia Stock Broking for front-running trades. The investigation spanned from April 1, 2021, to March 31, 2022, involving these entities. Evidence indicated that brokers facilitated these trades by providing necessary infrastructure and assistance.

news.headline: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank reports sixth consecutive quarterly loss
news.summary: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank experienced a loss of Rs 70 crore in the second quarter, marking six consecutive quarters of decline. The lender’s operating profit was Rs 85 crore, but provisions of Rs 166 crore led to the net loss. Its gross non-performing asset ratio improved slightly, standing at 5.96% at the end of September. The bank's gross loan portfolio saw a year-on-year growth of 7.5%, reaching Rs 20,062 crore.

news.headline: Happiest Minds Q2 Results: Profit rises 15% to Rs 62 crore; revenue up 12% to Rs 645 crore
news.summary: Happiest Minds Technologies has seen a 15.12% rise in consolidated net profit for the September quarter FY27. Revenue from operations also increased by 12.5% compared to the previous year. The company announced an interim dividend of Rs 3.05 per equity share for the 2026-27 fiscal year. An exceptional charge was included in the quarter's results due to a proposed merger with ITC Infotech.

news.headline: Hunting for Diwali winners? 8 brokerages name 58 stocks with big upside potential; Eternal, L&T among top picks
news.summary: Eight brokerages have shortlisted 58 stocks for their Diwali 2026 portfolios across sectors such as banking, IT, defence, automobiles and hospitality. Eternal, L&T and Indian Hotels are the most popular picks, featuring in four brokerage portfolios each, while Kotak Mahindra Bank appears in three. ICICI Bank, Tech Mahindra, Tata Steel and Adani Ports are among the other recurring recommendations.

news.headline: Taco Bell sales fall more than expected on cyclosporiasis outbreak hit
news.summary: Yum Brands faced a setback in the third quarter as Taco Bell reported declining sales, primarily due to a cyclosporiasis outbreak that sparked customer concerns. While the outbreak severely impacted customer traffic, there was a notable recovery in sales during September and October. Although same-store sales remained flat, falling short of analysts' predictions, the company surpassed profit expectations, boosting investor trust in Yum Brands.

news.headline: Polymarket unit gets US industry organization's approval to be futures broker
news.summary: Polymarket has received approval from the National Futures Association for PM Derivatives LLC to act as a broker. This approval allows the company to expand its operations if it obtains further approval from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission. The firm is actively under investigation by the CFTC regarding its marketing practices. Currently, Polymarket serves as a popular platform for betting on various events and elections.

news.headline: Minda Corp Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 68% to Rs 143 crore on strong revenue growth
news.summary: Minda Corporation Ltd has reported a significant 68.2% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit for Q2. Revenue from operations also increased by 42.6% year-on-year, reaching Rs 2,189 crore. The company's Chairman highlighted continued progress in their growth strategy across key vehicle segments. Electric vehicle-related products contributed around 35% of new order wins during this quarter. Minda plans to enhance its product offerings and invest in R&D and manufacturing capabilities.

news.headline: MFs cut stakes in 8 smallcap stocks after two quarters of buying; shares tumble up to 30% in 3 months
news.summary: Mutual funds reduced their holdings in 79 BSE small-cap stocks during the September 2026 quarter, reversing two quarters of accumulation. Several affected stocks fell sharply, with major laggards declining between 24% and 32% over three months.

news.headline: 4 reasons why Reliance Industries shares can rally after Monday magic sparked historic 12% surge
news.summary: Reliance Industries shares surged, their biggest single-day gain since April 2020, adding nearly Rs 2 lakh crore to the company's market capitalisation after strong Q2 results. Despite remaining down over 17% in 2026, analysts see further upside potential, citing positive fundamental and technical cues.

news.headline: Record-breaking FII selling may have peaked, says Nomura. Why the Nifty target could rise
news.summary: FIIs may be nearing the end of their record selling spree in Indian equities as outflows ease, earnings beat expectations and valuations fall below post-pandemic averages, according to Nomura. Foreign investors sold around $8.8 billion since September 15, although the pace has moderated. Meanwhile, companies in Nomura’s BSE 200+ universe reported 34% year-on-year profit growth, beating consensus estimates by 18%.

news.headline: LTCG abolition may cost just Rs 40,000–50,000 crore, SBI estimates show
news.summary: SBI Research estimates that abolishing long-term capital gains (LTCG) tax would cost the government just Rs 40,000–50,000 crore in FY27, far below the Rs 1.3 lakh crore collected in FY25. Weaker stock market returns and sustained foreign investor outflows have significantly reduced expected collections, suggesting the move may not derail the government's fiscal consolidation plans.

news.headline: Karur Vysya Bank among 4 F&O stocks with sharp rise in futures open interest
news.summary: A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a substantial rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security.

news.headline: US Treasury yields climb as strong jobs data, midterm polls weigh; 10-year yield eyes 5% again
news.summary: US Treasury yields climbed as stronger than expected September jobs data pointed to a resilient labour market, while investors awaited the midterm election results. Falling oil prices briefly eased pressure on bonds, but the move reversed as economic data reinforced growth expectations and uncertainty over future US fiscal policy kept investors cautious.
